# Engagement Charter

This charter defines how Meridian Advisory Group engages with its clients.
Its headings carry their own numbers, so the table of contents is configured
with `toc.numbered: false` to list them verbatim instead of double-numbering
them.

## 1. Purpose

Establish a shared understanding of the engagement's objectives, the
services provided, and the responsibilities of each party before any work
begins.

## 2. Scope of Services

Services are delivered in two tracks, each with its own cadence and
deliverables.

### 2.1 Advisory

Quarterly strategy sessions, ad-hoc counsel on request, and an annual
portfolio review.

### 2.2 Reporting

Monthly written status reports and a consolidated year-end summary.

## 3. Governance

| Role | Responsibility | Cadence |
|------|----------------|---------|
| Engagement lead | Overall delivery and escalations | Weekly |
| Client sponsor | Priorities and acceptance | Monthly |
| Steering group | Direction and budget | Quarterly |

## 4. Terms

The engagement runs for twelve months from the effective date and renews
automatically unless either party gives sixty days' written notice.
